flags.title: Terrain
flags.notes:
Split terrain into Terrain + Slope.

For maps of not standart size like 20x10: explicitly mark them as such, without rendering unplayable area as even terrain. Big example: dualgap adaptive

flags.notes: Should probably be merged with access structure. Also 2 layers: structures accesible to hover units and structures ONLY accesible via air drop.

flags.notes: Very poor estimation for main base + safe + own expansion + contestable + "fight for/hotzone" mexes.

flags.title: Main battle paths
flags.notes: Battlepaths MUST somehow connect and result in a direct connection between bases. Paths most not abruptly end randomly. Current estimation approach is lacking that.

flags.title: Air · Offensive drops
flags.notes: Not mirrored results. No weight to determine which place is better than the other. All look equal. Needs rating: good spot vs better spot. Same for all air estimations.
